object: air-to-air heat pumps in urban space heating
problem: What energy, CO2 and local climate impacts would a switch to air-to-air heat pumps have in a mid-latitude city?
mechanism_or_method: Urban climate and building energy simulation of heat pump adoption in Toulouse, comparing electric and gas heating baselines.
limitation: Single city with a specific heating mix; results may not transfer to fossil-heavy grids.
decision_relevance: Informs urban heat pump transition policy and grid planning.

problem: Can pore size and silanol groups in a zeolite jointly separate benzene from cyclohexane to ultrapure levels?
mechanism_or_method: Ordered silanols in -SVR zeolite bind benzene reversibly via SiOH...pi interactions, shown by breakthrough tests, in situ FTIR, DFT and AIMD.
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough tests under ambient conditions; scale-up and long-term stability not addressed.

object: social impacts of materials in green energy technologies
problem: Which critical materials in green energy technologies bring the greatest social benefits and risks?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic material-energy flow model integrating system dynamics, social life cycle assessment and geometallurgical approaches.
limitation: Depends on social indicator databases and scenario assumptions; limited indicator set.
decision_relevance: Guides material choice and sourcing policy for energy transition.

object: EGF-domain proteins and chitosan underwater adhesion
problem: How do EGF domains in byssal proteins bind GlcNAc-based polysaccharides to give underwater adhesion?
mechanism_or_method: Surface forces apparatus measurements of EGF-protein adhesion to chitosan of varying acetylation on mica.
limitation: Model-surface measurements on mica; real tissue or marine conditions not tested.

problem: Can a catheter change stiffness instantly without heating to speed minimally invasive surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Hundreds of ultrathin fibers in a 2.3 mm catheter jam under vacuum, giving up to 6.5-fold stiffness change in under 300 ms.
limitation: Bench-level prototype; in vivo performance and clinical validation not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors jamming over phase-change stiffening in catheter design.

problem: What governs how long an object stays adhered to a surface before sudden detachment?
mechanism_or_method: Rheological theory combining bulk rheology and interfacial viscoelasticity, with lifetime predictions validated by adhesion experiments.
limitation: Validated on model viscoelastic materials; generality to other interfaces untested.
decision_relevance: Enables adhesive lifetime prediction for design of bonded joints.

object: spatiotemporal acoustic vortices with oriented orbital angular momentum
problem: Can acoustic vortices be generated with arbitrarily oriented orbital angular momentum?
mechanism_or_method: A 2D acoustic phased array rotates vortices in 3D space or intersects vortices carrying different OAM types.
limitation: Demonstrated in lab acoustic fields; particle manipulation applications only suggested.

problem: How to hydrogenate liquid organic hydrogen carriers with CO-containing crude H2 without catalyst poisoning?
mechanism_or_method: Pd/alpha-MoC with water solvent uses low-temperature water gas shift to remove CO; positively charged Pd suppresses H2 release.
limitation: Lab reactor tests with model crude H2 gas mixtures; long-term stability not shown.

object: HiPIMS thin film deposition on insulators
problem: How to accelerate metal ions onto insulating substrates at low temperature without damaging films?
mechanism_or_method: Synchronized floating-potential HiPIMS times ion arrival with the substrate's transient negative floating potential during discharge.
limitation: Proof of concept on AlScN films; other materials only claimed to work.
decision_relevance: Enables low-temperature crystalline film growth on insulators in standard PVD tools.

problem: How large is the scientific literature on carbon dioxide removal and where is it concentrated?
mechanism_or_method: AI-enhanced systematic mapping to classify tens of thousands of studies by method, research type and region.
limitation: Mapping depends on search strategy and classifier accuracy; no assessment of study quality.

problem: How do by-product and host metal markets interact in price and production at the mine level?
mechanism_or_method: Multicommodity supply curve model of jointly produced commodities applied to the copper-cobalt-nickel system.
limitation: Relies on mine-level cost data and assumptions; not validated against realized market outcomes.

object: thin film nanocomposite cation exchange membrane for lithium
problem: How to selectively extract Li+ over Na+ and Ca2+ with a scalable membrane?
mechanism_or_method: Polyamide layer with amine-functionalized lithium titanium oxide nanoparticles by interfacial polymerization gives Li+-exclusive pathways; MD shows dehydration.
limitation: Lab-scale electrodialysis with synthetic solutions; real brine performance and durability unclear.

problem: What are the atomic-scale steps and optimal pH for CO2 mineralization on wet mineral surfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Reactive and non-reactive molecular simulations with well-tempered metadynamics map five-step pathway in a water-filmed portlandite mesopore.
limitation: Simulation only on one idealized mineral surface; no experimental validation.

object: soft robotic hand with visual-tactile sensing
problem: How to give soft grippers full-coverage multimodal haptic perception with high compliance?
mechanism_or_method: FlexiRay combines a Fin Ray soft gripper, multi-mirror optics, single camera and decoupled deep learning to sense force, texture and temperature.
limitation: Tested on lab benches; durability and complex real-world grasping scenarios are limited.
decision_relevance: Supports using compliant Fin Ray fingers for visual-tactile sensing designs.

object: anti-Janus nanofiltration membrane for lithium recovery
problem: How to raise Li+/divalent cation selectivity without sacrificing permeability in nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Quaternary ammonium electrolyte forms discrete micro-nano islands giving a mosaic-like charge structure that avoids electrostatic shielding.
limitation: Lab-scale tests with model Li/Co/Mn solutions; scale-up and fouling not shown.

problem: How to selectively recover Li, Mn, Ni and Co from battery leaching solutions at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Electro-membrane crystallization process integrating selective membranes, bipolar membranes, metal complexing and extracting, with techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Lab-scale demonstration; Co and Ni recovery and purity lower than Li and Mn.

problem: How does cation site occupancy in high-entropy spinels control oxygen evolution activity?
mechanism_or_method: Adding a sixth cation (Zn) shifts Co to octahedral sites, confirmed by DFT, synchrotron XAS and magnetic circular dichroism.
limitation: Small set of dopants tested; long-term device-level stability not demonstrated.

problem: Can distribution grids be mapped at scale from publicly available multi-modal data?
mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning framework combining street view images, road networks and building maps, benchmarked against California utility grid maps.
limitation: Precision about 80%; underground line fraction estimated only at aggregate level with R2 of 0.63.
decision_relevance: Enables grid planning and wildfire exposure assessment where utility maps are unavailable.

object: CO2-loaded polyethylenimine and nanoparticle organic hybrid electrolytes
problem: What carbon species and transport properties arise in polymer electrolytes after CO2 capture?
mechanism_or_method: Quantitative variable-temperature 13C NMR and pulsed-field-gradient 1H NMR combined with molecular dynamics.
limitation: Characterizes materials only; electrochemical conversion performance not tested.

problem: How does a radially symmetric epithelial dome transform into a curved fold shape during eversion?
mechanism_or_method: Cell-behavior mapping on 3D surfaces feeds a shape-programmability model; active spontaneous strains reproduce eversion, validated by MyoVI knockdown.
limitation: Single tissue and developmental stage; generality to other morphogenesis not shown.

problem: Can phase engineering push gold beyond the ideal strength limit of the FCC phase?
mechanism_or_method: Thickness-dependent FCC-HCP transformation in nanoflakes, AFM suspended nanoindentation, with first-principles and MD calculations.
limitation: Only ultrathin nanoflakes under 10 nm reach peak strength; scalability unclear.

problem: How can a system store multiple memories under asymmetric one-sided driving?
mechanism_or_method: Two hysterons with frustrated interaction violate return-point memory, forming a hysteron latch with multiple memories.
limitation: Abstract-level model with two hysterons; no experimental realization reported.

object: Frank dislocation loops in fcc irradiated alloys
problem: Can loop morphology reveal whether radiation-induced dislocation loops are interstitial or vacancy type?
mechanism_or_method: Correlate circular versus segmented loop shapes with nature, explained by dissociation into Shockley partial and stair-rod dislocations.
limitation: Rule varies for low-SFE and high-entropy alloys; relies on irradiation and microscopy experiments.

problem: How to wirelessly power implants independent of the intervening medium, unlike ultrasound?
mechanism_or_method: Oscillating magnetic field moves elastomeric magnets into contact with electrodes, producing contact electrification output.
limitation: Bench demonstration through tissue and materials; output power and in vivo operation not established.

problem: Can a membrane switch its molecular sieving cutoff depending on the solvent?
mechanism_or_method: Porous graphene in GO membrane changes dominant nanochannel from GO-GO to GO-PG in methanol, expanding interlayer spacing.
limitation: Lab-scale small membranes; stability over long cycling and scale-up not shown.

problem: How to overcome nanoparticle agglomeration to raise energy release efficiency of nanothermite?
mechanism_or_method: V2C MXene templates ordered self-assembly of Al and CuO nanoparticles via electrostatic and Cu-O-V bonding, tuning combustion.
limitation: Lab-scale synthesis and tests; microinitiator integration only proposed.

problem: How to break the strength-ductility tradeoff in an ultrafine-grained medium entropy alloy?
mechanism_or_method: Activate non-basal slip in ordered HCP superlattice nanoprecipitates within a fully recrystallized FCC/HCP architecture.
limitation: Lab-scale processed samples; fatigue, cost and scale-up not addressed.

problem: How to achieve fatigue-resistant, functional adhesion between hydrogels and tissues?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid chitosan nanowhiskers form an interpenetrated interface layer that kinks and arrests cracks, delivered via enhancers, microneedles or ultrasound.
limitation: Tested on ex vivo tissue and hydrogels; long-term in vivo performance not shown.

problem: Can H2S in natural gas be electrochemically converted to sulfate under mild conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Cathodically generated in-situ H2O2 drives deep oxidation of H2S in flow reactors, with life-cycle and techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Tested up to 100 cm2 flow reactor and 100 h; industrial scale unproven.

object: acoustic emission signals from deforming metals
problem: How to identify co-existing deformation mechanisms such as dislocation slip and cracking from acoustic emission?
mechanism_or_method: Knowledge-driven unsupervised learning aggregates gradient-driven base learners with knowledge-infused loss, linked to avalanche theory.
limitation: Tested on tensile tests of porous 316L; transfer to other materials shown only briefly.
decision_relevance: Supports real-time early failure warning from acoustic emission monitoring.

problem: How to give hydrogel microrobots multimodal locomotion with faster, lower-energy light actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Truncated octahedron lattice of PNIPAM-SWNT hydrogel lowers density; sequential laser scanning drives peristalsis, rotation and hopping.
limitation: Needs external laser setup; speeds remain slow and operation is only shown in lab media.

problem: Can structure, manufacturing, material and stimuli be co-designed autonomously for target shape morphing?
mechanism_or_method: Generalized topology optimization with hybrid data-physics differentiable simulation, realized by multimaterial 3D printing of liquid crystal elastomers.
limitation: Demonstrated on network-like systems with a specific printing process and LCE materials.
decision_relevance: Automates design of shape-morphing structures under heat and light.

problem: How to get ultrafast transport of both polar and non-polar solvents through polyamide membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Non-planar diphenyl ether amine monomer interfacial polymerization at deep eutectic solvent/alkane interface yields thin microporous Janus-like layer.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; scale-up and long-term solvent exposure not detailed.

object: photovoltaic waste and secondary materials supply
problem: How much can anthropogenic mineral circularity supply global photovoltaic material demand and cut waste?
mechanism_or_method: Global material flow modeling of five PV technologies under energy scenarios, with criticality, economic and emissions assessment.
limitation: Scenario-dependent projections to 2050 with assumed recycling rates and lifetimes.
decision_relevance: Guides PV recycling capacity and material circularity policy planning.

object: European green steel markets and carbon policy
problem: When does hydrogen-based steelmaking become cost-competitive under EU ETS and carbon border adjustment?
mechanism_or_method: Techno-economic and policy analysis of EU climate policy revisions, including relocation of ironmaking and trade of hot briquetted iron.
limitation: Depends on projected policy, energy prices and technology costs; commercial deployment still unproven.

object: aluminum matrix composites with rebar-concrete-inspired structure
problem: How to improve mechanical performance of aluminum matrix composites via a rebar-reinforced concrete-inspired architecture?
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale reinforcing architecture combined with anomalous temperature-dependent deformation of Ti-containing reinforcement; abstract is truncated.
limitation: Abstract is incomplete; scalability and detailed property trade-offs are unclear.

problem: Can additive manufacturing give a commercial titanium alloy high strength together with strong strain hardening?
mechanism_or_method: AM martensite with triple-twinned substructure progressively detwins into single-twinned lamellae during tension, raising flow stress.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; fatigue and build-geometry sensitivity not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Supports AM process choice for tougher, work-hardening titanium parts.

problem: Can scattering by obstacles be suppressed across an ultra-broad acoustic bandwidth?
mechanism_or_method: Subwavelength tunnels with crafted internal structure guide waves around obstacles and recreate the incoming wavefront at the exit surface.
limitation: Works below a frequency limit set by tunnel width; lab-scale samples only.

problem: Can direct air capture be coupled with methane production at lower energy and cost?
mechanism_or_method: Bipolar membrane electrodialysis co-generates CO2 and H2 in one compartment, followed by thermochemical methanation.
limitation: Proof-of-concept scale with high energy per mole of methane; techno-economics are predictions.

problem: Where and with what material properties do thermo-responsive windows save the most building energy globally?
mechanism_or_method: Over 2.8 million building simulations across 2000+ locations feed neural network models to produce world heatmaps and an open mapping tool.
limitation: Simulation-based with assumed building models; no field validation of window performance.
decision_relevance: Guides climate-specific selection of window material transition temperatures.

object: Ti-Cr-Mo quinary out-of-plane ordered MAX phases
problem: Can solid solutions of two o-MAX phases yield multicomponent o-MAX with preserved chemical ordering?
mechanism_or_method: Mix Cr2.5Ti1.5AlC3 and Mo2Ti2AlC3 at set ratios; DFT analyses bonding and predicts mechanical properties.
limitation: Only three compositions studied; mechanical data limited to compressive strength and energy dissipation.

problem: How to build a fast insect-scale robot that can actively morph and self-recover?
mechanism_or_method: Arc-heating actuator provides kinetic and thermal energy to deform shape memory alloy wires, coupling actuation and morphing.
limitation: Tethered lab prototype; energy supply and autonomous operation not addressed in abstract.

object: pneumatic torsion strips for soft robot shape morphing
problem: How to bend soft bodies locally over large curvature without in-plane strain or stiffness change?
mechanism_or_method: Bent and twisted bladder ribbons (Mobius-inspired) on braided bodies exert bending torque; a mathematical model of geometry and elastic energy.
limitation: Demonstrated in prototype case studies; control precision and durability not quantified.
decision_relevance: Offers strain-free bending actuators for transformable soft structures.

object: high-speed railway infrastructure monitored by telecom fiber
problem: Can existing trackside telecom fibers inspect high-speed railway health through daily train-induced vibrations?
mechanism_or_method: Laser interferometer distributed vibration sensing with an average power spectral density indicator, observed over one year.
limitation: Few infrastructure types and one maintenance case; no direct comparison with inspection vehicle quantified.
decision_relevance: Supports fiber-based continuous monitoring as supplement to track recording vehicles.

object: net-zero pathways with separate removal targets
problem: What are the cost impacts of separating CO2 emission reduction targets from removal targets?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario analysis with the REMIND integrated assessment model comparing integrated and separated emission and novel CDR targets.
limitation: Single integrated assessment model with assumptions on CDR costs and potentials.

object: adaptive electronics for wearable sensor power harvesting
problem: How to cut battery needs of skin-interfaced wireless sensors using ambient light?
mechanism_or_method: Tri-modal harvesting with photometric sensing, multijunction photovoltaics and photoluminescent packaging, plus in-sensor computation and RF charging.
limitation: Depends on ambient light availability; abstract gives no quantitative power or long-term wear results.

problem: How to remove small neutral organic contaminants while keeping water permeance high in RO membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembled amphiphilic CdII/L-cysteine nanowire interface shuttles MPD monomers, giving a defect-suppressed ultraselective polyamide layer.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; cadmium use and long-term stability raise scale-up concerns.

object: silicon nanocolumn capacitive ultrasound transducer patch
problem: Can a lead-free, flexible, disposable ultrasound patch support wearable imaging and blood pressure monitoring?
mechanism_or_method: Silicon nanocolumn CMUT array enhances displacement efficiency, giving thin flexible patch with 8.9 VPP operation.
limitation: Small human demonstration on carotid arteries; long-term wear and reliability not shown.

problem: How to raise water and solvent permeance while keeping selectivity and low fouling in polyamide membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Nanomolding phase inversion makes pillar-array patterns on Kevlar hydrogel supports guiding interfacial polymerization of textured polyamide layers.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; large-area nanoimprinting manufacturing feasibility not demonstrated.

problem: Can high-entropy ceramic nanolattices achieve simultaneous high strength and energy absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent metal-salt precursors with two-photon polymerization and two-step sintering make dense nanolattices; high-entropy effect raises dislocation density.
limitation: Nanoscale specimens fabricated by slow two-photon printing; scalability to bulk parts is limited.

object: polymer nanocomposites with bound polymer loops
problem: How to keep high-filler nanocomposite melts flowing while improving toughness and strength?
mechanism_or_method: Bound polymer loops on particle surfaces relax freely, forming a dynamic loose particle network instead of a quasi-permanent bridged network.
limitation: Specific polymer-particle systems in lab; generality across fillers and matrices unverified.

problem: How to match evaporation and condensation capacity to maximize passive solar water production?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric tapered eight-stage still with tunable mass transfer gap optimizes condensation-to-evaporation area ratio.
limitation: Outdoor tests are short; long-term fouling and scale-up costs are not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides condensation-to-evaporation area ratio in multistage solar still design.

problem: How to retain strength of aluminum alloys at elevated temperatures using additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Near-eutectic AlLaScZr printed by laser powder bed fusion forms thermally stable nanoscale eutectic cellular network that cages dislocation motion.
limitation: Contains costly Sc and La; creep, fatigue and large-part performance not reported.
decision_relevance: Supports printed Al alloys for components at about 300 C.

problem: How to replicate spider silk's hierarchical structure and properties in scalable synthetic fibers?
mechanism_or_method: Wet-spinning with antisolvent-induced microphase separation followed by post-drawing strain programming aligns microfibrils and forms crystallites.
limitation: Lab wet-spinning; moisture sensitivity and long-term durability limit applications.

problem: Can a lightweight, load-bearing, conformable skin deliver ultrabroadband radar absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Chain-mail-inspired topologically interlocked units combine mechanical robustness with electromagnetic absorption from 2 to 40 GHz.
limitation: Demonstrated on a drone wing prototype; harsh-environment durability and large-scale manufacture untested.
decision_relevance: Supports interlocked metastructures for conformal load-bearing stealth skins.

problem: How to overcome the activity-selectivity trade-off in selective catalytic oxidation of ammonia?
mechanism_or_method: Ir sites oxidize NH3 to NO, which reacts with NH3 on adjacent W sites via SCR to N2, shown by operando studies and DFT.
limitation: Powder catalyst lab tests; durability, water tolerance and practical exhaust conditions not shown.

problem: How to make scalable, durable radiative coolers with low filler loading and architected forms?
mechanism_or_method: Rheology-optics coupling links polymer viscoelasticity to particle dispersion and scattering; direct ink writing prints daylight-regulating architectures.
limitation: Pilot-scale tests only; long-term outdoor aging and cost versus paint not fully established.
decision_relevance: Favors printable low-filler PDMS coatings for building cooling load reduction.

problem: How to separate propylene from propane with both high capacity and fast diffusion in a molecular sieve?
mechanism_or_method: Gate-channel-cavity MOF architecture combines sieving gates, wide diffusion channels and central cavities, tested by adsorption and breakthrough experiments.
limitation: Lab-scale single-cycle breakthrough tests; scale-up and long-term cycling stability unclear.

problem: Can friction of graphene be controllably and reversibly reduced by high-stress pre-rubbing?
mechanism_or_method: Pre-rubbing lowers sliding barrier and raises contact stiffness via stronger substrate adhesion from interfacial charge transfer, shown by DFT.
limitation: Nanoscale friction measurements on atomically thin films; macroscale lubrication relevance unclear.

problem: How to achieve multi-axis force sensing and decoupled gripping for delicate cochlear implant microsurgery?
mechanism_or_method: Pneumatic gripper with fiber Bragg grating 6-axis force sensing on a spherical parallel mechanism and robotic arm.
limitation: Validated only on cadaveric temporal bone and head; no live patient trials.
